submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.070%) at Sb fraction 0.415. EQE was measured at Sb = 0.21, 0.41, 0.45, 0.67 and 0.81, and the values rise to a maximum near 0.41. A log-parabola fit put the peak near 0.456, but index 13 (0.446) came in lower at 0.036%, so the true maximum is probably at or just below 0.41. XRD at Sb = 0.33, 0.41 and 0.51 shows the same rutile/trirutile-type pattern. At 0.41 there is also a weak low-Q peak at 0.91 Å⁻¹, possibly a trirutile superlattice reflection. These scans did not separate the compositions by phase.

rejected.reason: EQE is about zero (slightly negative) on the Sb-rich side
